## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename leaves the AGENTS.md pre-push instruction pointing at `make test`, a target that no longer exists; fix it, because the guide names that command as one of the only checks a change gets. The new Layout section matches the files at the pull-request head.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check`, updates the README's test command to match, and adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md listing each file and the Makefile targets.

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the `make test` command in AGENTS.md to `make check` — Running `make test`, which `AGENTS.md:24` still instructs before every push, fails with no rule for that target because this line renames it to `check`. The diff's only AGENTS.md hunk adds the Layout section and leaves the Commands section unchanged. — Contributors and agents following the guide get a make error instead of a test run, in a repository the guide says has no CI. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to read `make check`.
